description:
AquaDeep Colombo Solo project

My project is about Earths drinkable groundwater. I study 6 things: purity, color, taste, pH, temperature and depth from surface.

I use NASA data: GRACE for depth, Landsat for color, SMAP for purity, ECOSTRESS for temperature.

I will make a CAD design of a 6 in 1 water scanner for villages. This scanner can check if water is safe to drink.

Solo team from Colombo, virtual, no members needed.
summary: AquaDeep is a low-cost, portable 6-in-1 device that tests village well water in 10 seconds. Just dip, press, and get a Green / Yellow / Red result - Drinkable, Boil First, or Do Not Drink. It protects rural families in Sri Lanka's dry zone from hidden chemicals, salt, and bacteria that cause CKDu (Chronic Kidney Disease). It uses NASA Earthdata to predict which wells are at risk before people get sick.
details: PROBLEM: In Sri Lanka, well water looks clean but is not safe. It contains Fluoride, Nitrate, Hardness, Salt (TDS), Bacteria, and Algae. A lab test costs Rs. 5,000+ and takes 3 days. People in Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa get CKDu because they drink this water every day without knowing. SOLUTION: AquaDeep is a small, battery-powered scanner. The user dips it in a well or a bottle. In 10 seconds, it tests 6 things: 1. Fluoride, 2. Nitrate, 3. Hardness, 4. TDS / Taste (Salinity), 5. Bacteria, 6. Algae / pH Result is shown with light + Sinhala / Tamil voice: GREEN = Drinkable YELLOW = Boil First RED = Do Not Drink WHO USES IT? Village families, school children, farmers, and health officers. One device can test a whole village. FUTURE PLAN: Phase 1: Test 50 wells in Anuradhapura in 6 months. Phase 2: Give 100 devices to schools. Phase 3: Connect to a mobile app to map safe wells in Sri Lanka.
